familySummary: Livo dining chairs combine a clean dining-room profile with Comfort foam seating and a warm tan look suited to everyday meals and gatherings.
familyDescription: The Livo dining chair brings a simple, modern presence to the dining room. Its tan PU finish and compact proportions make it easy to pair with a range of table styles, while the oak, plywood and wood structure gives it a grounded, natural character. Designed for dining spaces, it features comfort foam seating for an inviting place to sit at meals, conversations and everyday use. The chair measures 47 × 53 × 83 cm, giving it a neat footprint that fits around the table.
